nodes.label: 0.3.32-wideview: widen cloned-cbuffer stereo proof to more route families, accepting visual distortion to test whether larger per-eye separation is possible without crashing
0.3.33-wideeye: add dedicated proof-eye latch so temporal left/right OpenXR capture becomes deterministic instead of starving on eye=1 only
0.3.34-sustainedwide: clamp out-of-range scales only under wide-proof mode so the visual proof survives HMD motion without weakening the non-wide fail-closed gate
0.3.35-directdraw: replay DrawIndexed twice with forced left/right cbuffers into the same HDR target, accepting a ghosted overlay as an acceptable interim visual signal
0.3.36-stalefallback: invalidate cached temporal eye readiness when no fresh stereo candidate exists, fixing a frozen-HMD-while-desktop-updates bug
0.3.37-xractivity: pass explicit activity mask from Present to OpenXR so direct-replay frames are counted as stereo activity, not just the older numeric-proof counter
0.3.38-sustainedproof: raise proof budgets to 16384/2048 and add post-proof heartbeat to distinguish live mono fallback from a stopped XR feed
0.3.39-eyetargetscout: stop raising same-target caps; scout private left/right HDR/depth target allocation as a guarded preflight before bind/draw/copy
0.3.40-eyetargetbind: bind and draw into private left/right targets and restore original render state, testing whether that can be done cleanly
0.3.41-eyeblitproof: de-risk the OpenXR blit path with a solid fullscreen-triangle proof before accumulated private HDR becomes the presentation source
0.3.42-privatehdrblit: switch the OpenXR eye-blit source to copied private HDR eye targets once both eyes are fresh, falling back to solid proof otherwise
0.3.43-sustainedprivatehdr: raise the private bind/present proof window to 4096 to keep partial HDR geometry visible long enough to judge separation
0.3.44-privateproducer: add a sustain gate bypassing proof-limit checks to test continuous producer freshness instead of just raising another cap
0.3.45-calibratedstereo: replace raw FOV/proof offsets (~+/-0.242) with physical-IPD-derived convergence shift (~+/-0.02), holding vsScale/psScale at 1.0
0.3.46-stereoconvention: add runtime-tunable local-eye/sign controls with explicit applied-state logging to isolate a suspected left/right convention mismatch
0.3.47-localeye: enable the calibrated local-eye VS row write as the next single-variable A/B after projection-only calibration failed to fix fusion
0.3.48-signflip: supersede the untested 0.3.47-localeye handoff; flip global stereo sign instead, since local-eye is a secondary term versus the base left/right convention
0.3.49-splitsigns: split VS projection sign from PS reconstruction sign to isolate whether reconstruction rows compensate in the wrong direction, after flicker persisted
0.3.50-stablewide: pause sign-only probing since global sign changes did not fuse the image; broaden private accumulation to whole HDR+depth pass as mono for unknown draws
0.3.51-monoisolate: add a gate to bypass strict stereo mutation while keeping broad mono accumulation, isolating whether flicker comes from stereo mutation or accumulation
0.3.52-depthreproject: pivot to depth-weighted whole-scene XR blit as the smallest parallax proof that reuses the already-confirmed color path without game-memory writes
0.3.53-blitcalibrate: make the eye-blit aspect/FOV-zero aware using live OpenXR per-eye FovF instead of guessing BioShock FOV from per-object worldViewProj
0.3.54-depthwindow: smooth the biased raw-depth response because one_minus_raw saturated broad D24 ranges and made near-object parallax collapse
0.3.55-linearizedepth: linearize inverse-Z depth around a finite convergence plane so near/mid/far ranges get distinct parallax instead of collapsing near-camera
0.3.56-depthdebug: add optional linear-depth-gray and disparity-magnitude debug views so a single future HMD test can answer more than looks-better/worse
0.3.57-matrixstereoproof: stop polishing screen-space 2.5D depth warp; pivot to native geometry proof replaying HDR world draws with cloned VS0 WVP matrix deltas
0.3.58-nativevs-pcenter: replace the flat post-projection WVP shift (a constant NDC offset, not true parallax) with a VS-only P_center^-1*T_eye*P_center eye-translation
0.3.59-nativevs-isolate: make the private target transformed-only and affine-pass-only, after mono fallback mixed with matrix rows produced false geometry splits/holes

0.3.60-pcenterfitprobe: keep the affine gate strict after the guessed 75-degree P_center failed on live rows (residual ~96.65 vs limit 1.0); add bounded runtime projection-fit telemetry instead of loosening it
0.3.61-screendatapcenter: derive P_center per-draw from VS screenDataToCamera plus the WVP depth relation, which reduced affine residual from ~98 to near zero in a local check

0.3.62-matrixappliedtrace: treat the run as P_center validation (hFOV~100deg, near-zero residuals, 145167 applied vs 165426 fallback) and ask headset feedback split by render lane instead of a new RenderDoc capture
0.3.63-vscompanions: add independently gated vertexClipPlane and localEyePos companion-constant mutation to fix poster clip/fall-through and side-facing black shading
0.3.64-coherencescout: add a log-only PS reconstruction scout before attempting a blind PS mutation, after clip-plane companion proved a no-op and black-surface artifacts persisted
0.3.65-perfab: build a performance/A-B DLL and disable LocalEye companion for one variable before mutating PS reconstruction, since PS mutation remains the higher-risk change
0.3.66-compact320: track 320-byte compact-world VS cbuffers as a coverage fix for flat props/items, since fallbacks were dominated by missing_recent_vs_write_data on untracked compact lanes
0.3.67-shadowmaskab: replace target-sized s_shadowMask (PS slot 2) with a cached 1x1 white SRV during private eye replay only, as a cheap falsifiable test for eye-dependent black boulder shading
0.3.68-launchinject: back out the neutral-mask A/B (boulders got darker, artifacts unsolved) and add launch-suspended injection so a fresh RenderDoc capture can target the injected native route
0.3.69-eyedump: dump post-blit OpenXR eye textures to BMP instead of relying on RenderDoc compositor capture, after xrEndFrame repeatedly failed under RenderDoc in the 32-bit process
0.3.70-dumphotkey: switch eye dumps from an auto startup burst to a Ctrl+F10-armed burst so the user can capture the actual artifact instead of frames 1-2
0.3.71-artifactprobe: add a hotkey-scoped draw/resource manifest and a screen-space SRV fallback A/B, since blind neutral-white masking already proved insufficient
0.3.72-srvfilter: narrow the screen-space SRV fallback by slot mask (4) and min index count (18000) after broad slot-2 fallback fixed boulders but over-caught architecture/poster surfaces
0.3.73-compact320gate: let sparse compact 320-byte c0-c3 WVP windows reach the existing strict affine gate instead of widening the already-narrowed SRV fallback again
0.3.74-compactscan: add a sliding-window scan of every 4-row window c0-c16 for 320-byte VS buffers, since the c0-c3 sparse gate produced zero matches and papers/suitcases stayed flat

0.3.75-artifactids: enrich Ctrl+F10 rows with shader/cbuffer/input-layout/topology identity, since no clean alternate compact WVP window emerged and identity grouping is a better discriminator than more window guesses
0.3.76-psnulldepthskip: skip private-eye replay for PS-null/depth-only draws, since repeated runtime_320 ps=null rows correlated with poster/frame red-blue holes
0.3.77-psnulllogonly: revert the broad PS-null skip to log-only after it starved the private-eye producer entirely (cyan/yellow only); tighten eligibility since ps0=64 rows are not truly depth-only
0.3.78-psnullmonodepth: draw mono constants into both private depth targets for PS-null draws, testing whether a matrix-shifted depth prepass plus mono color explains object-shaped clear-color holes
0.3.79-psnullstrict: narrow mono-depth fallback to the strict no-PS-cbuffer predicate after the broad version flattened nearly all matrix stereo (2.1M fallbacks vs 1765 matrix-applied)
0.3.80-stereotoggle: add a Ctrl+F9 live stereo/mono comparison hotkey so subjective A/B testing does not require separate runs, after 0.3.78 showed no-errors could mean the stereo path was bypassed
0.3.81-priorarthints: treat the BioShock 3D Vision ShaderFixes package as shader-family evidence, not a runtime drop-in, and log-only classify artifact rows against its known constant/PS patterns

0.3.82-compactpsnullskip: add an exact compact predicate (ps=null, indexCount=36, vs0=320, ps0=64, worldViewProjCompact) since the broad/strict PS-null classes never matched the actual poster/frame suspect rows
0.3.83-fallbackdepthab: after a checkpoint commit, test private-eye clear-color mode and mono-fallback depth-write mode as more adventurous but reversible diagnostic knobs
0.3.84-compareguard: recover from the 0.3.83 fallback-depth regression (missing boulders, translucent suitcases) and make Ctrl+F9 mono-compare ignore any configured mono-fallback depth override
0.3.85-fallbackfitprobe: keep visuals conservative and add fit diagnostics for compact/affine-failed fallback rows, since every broad mutation attempt so far had caused no improvement or regression
0.3.86-compactc10apply: promote compact 320-byte c10-c13 as the WVP candidate behind the fit-apply gate, based on stronger live evidence than the earlier c0-c3 compact guess
0.3.87-dumpsync: make each Ctrl+F10 artifact arm also arm the OpenXR eye BMP dumper, since D3D artifact logging armed 11 times but the BMP dumper armed only twice
0.3.88-compactc10noskip: disable the compact PS-null skip now that compact c10 is mapped, since the skip may be blocking rows that could finally attempt matrix/private replay
0.3.89-depthpairdump: pivot from compact skip toggling to paired private-eye color/depth BMP dumps plus output-merger state, after the compact skip A/B was falsified as the visible root cause
0.3.90-fallbackcolorpass: test a narrow mono-fallback color-pass depth-state override, targeting real-PS mono passes with depth-test-on/depth-write-off that may be rejected by per-eye matrix depth
0.3.91-wvpcandidates: test alternate WVP row starts under the strict affine gate for known layouts (576/832/320), since loosening the gate is known-dangerous from the 0.3.58 displacement class

0.3.92-scale-srvrange: raise world-scale to 65000 and shorten dump bursts after 0.3.91 became the strongest content improvement, to make stereo separation easier to judge and reduce capture-time stalls
0.3.97-windowmatch: evaluate attribution match at Ctrl+F10 flush time against the same captured rows, since post-window Ctrl+F11 solo proved too brittle for interactive lane isolation
0.3.98-srvfamily: add opt-in per-route-family screen-space SRV fallback selectors (indexed-primitive/layer-model/BSP/material), enabling only indexed-primitive first for a reversible narrow A/B
0.3.99-shaderpacket: add shaderSignature/resourceSignature to attribution rows and ranked shader-summary output, since cbuffer-size/route-family grouping was too coarse for individual shader issues
0.3.100-exactsrv: add exact index-count selectors for target-sized screen-space SRV fallback as a narrower, currently more reliable selector than route family or unavailable shader hashes
0.3.101-bspexact: add a BSP-only exact-index selector for frame/curved-architecture holes, since low index counts were too common for the global exact list without requiring the BSP family too

0.3.103-vrfov-eye: treat the zoomed full-eye crop as a presentation/frustum problem, not another shader pass; render private eye targets at OpenXR eye size and use the runtime per-eye FOV for final projection
Treat D:\Dev Debug\UnrealPort as offline UE actor/property vocabulary reference only; its UE3 path is unfinished and it contains no D3D/OpenXR/stereo/camera-hook implementation to merge

Integrate docs/Engine Findings (BSP vs static-mesh vs dyn_* prop paths, material factory/mtb specialization, lightmap UV streams) as static triage priors for the split between working architecture and flat/broken props
0.3.149-focusprobe: keep an exact-callsite, log-only detour on AShockPlayerController::UpdateFocus; mutation forbidden until endpoint order/range/focus-state transitions are live-proven

Promote centered render/submission frusta to the startup baseline after Ctrl+F6 gave repeatable lighting-stability evidence matching SOMAVR's deferred-shadow fix; route snap-turn through native XInput right-stick since Windows mouse delivery never rotated BioShock
After 0.3.166 confirmed a stable authored grip with no flashing, make the next build an opt-in absolute head-relative grip placement/scale step, kept separate from AimIK/lighting/melee/aim changes

Keep incomplete per-eye shadow replacement disabled; build an observation-only hotkey-armed lifecycle capture tracing clear/copy/resolve/mipmap operations, since prior consumer evidence was invalid (rows had no pixel shader)

Keep fixed HUD/crosshair in the final-LDR/Flash capture domain rather than hooking AShockHUD::RenderHealthBars, since that function renders world-space actor bars under a different projection contract
Stop vanilla-only live tracing on the desktop-mirror shell artifact; reproduce it under the injected build and correlate native pass-call counts with D3D targets/SRVs before any new suppression rule

Drive native AimIK from a stable inferred torso frame: native yaw owns heading, HMD position translates shoulder centre, calibrated grip owns wrist, BioShock's post-animation AimIK owns upper-arm/forearm/hand, avoiding a duplicate custom solver

Replace zero-layer xrEndFrame comfort frames with black-cleared eye swapchains submitted through the normal projection layer, to keep runtime/D3D swapchain ownership stable across the recurring Virtual Desktop fail-fast crash
P_center native projection reconstruction (BioShock's row-vector WVP/affine-validation reference for per-eye VS matrix stereo)
screenDataToCamera VS constant (c3-c5 or c4-c6) used to derive live horizontal/vertical FOV and near/far for empirical P_center
Compact 320-byte VS worldViewProjCompact layout family (candidate WVP row windows c0-c3 then c10-c13) covering props/items separate from BSP 576/832-byte layouts
Mono screen-space s_shadowMask / attenuation-mask producer sampled once for the center/mono view, causing eye-dependent black shading and stretched projected-light artifacts
Initial report: taking a new RenderDoc capture crashes the game; later narrowed to only after the wrench has been picked up/equipped in vanilla gameplay (BS3 pre-pickup captures worked fine)

Equipped-wrench RenderDoc failure confirmed as 32-bit virtual-address-space exhaustion/fragmentation inside RenderDoc's D3D11 capture allocator, not a BioShock exception; first-chance C++ exceptions were debugger noise around it

world_candidate_sample classifier accepted live 576/832-byte cbuffer allocations that overlap the confirmed wrench/tool viewmodel lane, so worldCandidates evidence was actually viewmodel contamination, not world geometry

0.2.6-worldstrict: tightened world classifier drops worldCandidates to 0 across 329 frames while wrench/tool classification stays intact, confirming the earlier world-evidence contamination is resolved

Repeated hook_config viewmodelProbe=0/detailedInspection=0 logs across several sessions were a test-setup problem: the diagnostic environment variables never reached the injected game process, confirmed by Frida reading them as null in-process

0.2.4-config-shaderprobe: switching diagnostic toggles to an INI-file fallback (detailedSource=ini) finally got viewmodelProbe/shaderProbe live in the injected process, fixing the recurring env-var delivery problem

Exact runtime cbuffer ByteWidth matching against RenderDoc reflection sizes was too strict: RenderDoc reflected 544/752 bytes while live D3D11 buffer objects at the same draws were 576/832 bytes, so viewmodel_candidate_sample stayed zero despite confirmed evidence

0.3.118-cameraanalyzer: every sampled camera-constructor sample reported identityValid=0, but this was a diagnostic classification error, not a bad hook -- argument 4 was actually the view target/pawn, a different vtable than the controller

0.3.119-cameraidentity: validating the controller through viewport+0x48 instead of constructor argument 4 makes identityValid=1 consistently, live-confirming the native player-camera boundary before any pose mutation
Theory: a DrawIndexed ordinal draw-order sub-band (161-320, later narrowed 161-192...289+) is the cause of the cyan/city shell artifact, based on mode-5 partially removing it in 0.3.110-shellbisect

0.3.112-uevrlanes: mode 8 removing a different band still left the shell visible, falsifying a single ordinal sub-band as the complete cause; reinterpreted as the private accumulator merging more than one engine render view (main camera plus reflection/portal/vista) into one private color/depth pair

0.3.113-viewprovenance: every sampled frame reports pairCount=1 for the same 1920x1080 HDR/depth resource pair, falsifying separate render-target pairs (reflection/portal/vista) as the room/vista boundary

0.3.114-viewepoch code inspection finds the real cause: private replay forced every source draw to a full-target viewport/scissor even though BioShock's original bounded rectangles had been captured for restoration

0.3.115-viewrect: preserving source viewport/scissor rectangles at matching (proportionally scaled) extents makes the cyan/city shell completely gone; user confirms all previously problematic shader classes now appear stereoscopic
Theory: compact vs0=320/ps0=64/indexCount=36 rows skipped from private replay (compact_ps_null36_private_depth_replay_skipped) are the cause of poster/paper/curved-geometry red-blue clear-color holes

0.3.88/0.3.89: disabling the compact skip makes those rows matrix-apply instead, but the visual artifacts remain unchanged and the rows are no-output (rt0WriteMask=0x0, depthWriteMask=0) -- compact PS-null skip is falsified as the visible root cause and becomes a red herring

0.3.98-srvfamily: enabling StereoWorldScreenSpaceSrvFallbackIndexedPrimitive=1 fires as intended (17k applied) but regresses tall stone elements, boulders, the chest, and the previously-good poster frame -- family-wide demotion is too broad and is rolled back

0.3.171-armshading: exact wrench foreground lighting companion rejected all ten attempts because live directional-light scale c29.x=-2.78524 failed an old non-negative inverse-radius guard, which incorrectly assumed light scale is never negative

A loose/floor wrench was repeatedly pulled to the camera for tracking before pickup, showing that index-only viewmodel classification is unsafe and must require equipped-hand/plasmid evidence instead of index/layout alone

BioShock repeatedly reported controller disconnected during 0.3.161 testing; only 16 synthetic XInput connected polls occurred (all during turn pulses), which is direct evidence of device-presence flapping rather than an OpenXR session failure

Recurring test-setup problem across many sessions (0.3.140/0.3.145-153): the user's positive gameplay observation (continuous yaw working) is repeatedly paired with a supplied log that is only the 16-line 0.3.140-inputsafety startup fragment, ending before hook_install complete and unable to serve as runtime evidence

0.3.122-native6dof: roll, forward/backward, left/right lean, and rise/crouch are all inverted; diagnosed as the scene-node decoded position being sign-adjusted/negated relative to engine world position, so adding world delta to it reversed every physical axis

0.3.123-horizontalbasis: after subtracting world delta and flipping roll, horizontal translation maps as an exact +90-degree output rotation (forward->right, left->forward, backward->left, right->backward), not independent axis inversion or scale error

0.3.124-horizontalbasis: a fixed -90-degree engine heading offset did not fully fix direction because Ctrl+F7 recentered position but not the horizontal basis; translation used currentPosition-baselinePosition directly in OpenXR stage axes, so behavior depended on physical facing when Ctrl+F7 was pressed

0.3.167/0.3.168: alleged tracked-mask HDR consumers of the shadow-mask resource are themselves PS-null draws, making them false positives caused by retained SRV state rather than genuine consumers of the shadow producer

0.3.181-shadowmaskneutral: neutralizing the slot-2 mask suppresses the projected-light/shadow-mask artifact but also removes the desired gobo light projection entirely, because both live in the same mono screen-space mask -- an artifact killer, not a correct renderer

0.3.159: snap turn produced the expected black comfort frame but did not rotate the player -- the route was native_mouse_body_yaw via SendInput, and Windows mouse delivery does not rotate BioShock, so the next probe must route through native XInput right-stick instead

0.3.91-wvpcandidates: testing alternate WVP row starts under the strict affine gate (rather than loosening it) gave suitcases geometry depth, fixed newspaper/paper black stereo duplication, and improved the poster frame at most angles

0.3.108-shelltrace log loaded StereoWorldProjectionFarMilli=10000000 even though the current on-disk INI was 65536000, flagging OneDrive-synced/stale-config risk as a recurring evidence-quality hazard separate from any code bug

0.3.178-enginecensus: enabling native AimIK together with absolute grip placement/orientation in the same build regressed wrench tracking to inconsistent rotation with the arm off-screen; the fix was isolating placement alone rather than treating it as a placement failure
